## Activity

During February 2021, Market Eye Clinic completed 239 captures. This records the activity undertaken during the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The reported capture total should be used when considering the proportions and volumes described below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 12 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.0 per cent of captures. The result indicates that a small proportion of submitted images could not be assessed and should continue to be monitored through routine site review.

## Grading

Grading identified 46 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during February 2021.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help maintain the quality and continuity of the service at Market Eye Clinic.
